subject.title: Discord leaks internal tool-call traces (NO_REPLY, commentary, to=functions) to channel

question: Should the remaining Discord envelope-shaped internal traces be blocked by a shared outbound sanitizer or only by a Discord-specific front-channel sanitizer?
rationale: The fix crosses a security-sensitive user-visible delivery boundary where undermatching leaks internal tool traces and overmatching can hide legitimate code or JSON content.

options.title: Shared outbound sanitizer
options.body: Extend the shared delivery sanitizer for known internal envelope shapes and require cross-channel false-positive tests before relying on channel adapters.

options.title: Discord-specific sanitizer
options.body: Keep the broader stripping logic in Discord reply/send delivery only and prove sibling channels are not exposed to the same envelope shapes.

options.title: Fold into #25592
options.body: Treat #44905 as a Discord-specific satellite of the broader channel text-leak policy issue and resolve it only through that canonical design path.

recommendation.title: Shared outbound sanitizer
recommendation.body: Extend the shared delivery sanitizer for known internal envelope shapes and require cross-channel false-positive tests before relying on channel adapters.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored recent merged work on both serialized tool-call stripping and Discord/front-channel sanitizer behavior that overlaps the remaining boundary.
